\providecommand{\RefitControl}{}\renewcommand{\RefitControl}{ The mirror of the experiment behaves as it should. With the central construction removed instead, the tail construction rises to rank 1 of 580 at a mean absolute attribution of 0.2537~years, against 0.2381 with both present, and out-of-fold $R^{2}$ is 0.6695 against 0.6680. Removing the weaker of the two descriptions therefore does not cost the model accuracy and leaves the stronger one where it was. Two halves of one split variable would not behave this way in both directions.}
